issues.description: Template uses an inconsistent attribute name when creating the query register: __init__ assigns self._query_register but the rest of the class (including run()) expects self.query_register. This will cause AttributeError / NameError at runtime and prevents students from even instantiating or running the starter code after filling the placeholder number of qubits. The solution implementation uses self.query_register consistently, so the template deviates structurally from the intended design.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the attribute name consistent in the template. Replace the line that creates the register (self._query_register = QuantumRegister(...)) with self.query_register = QuantumRegister(self.number_of_qubits_query_register). Ensure all uses (including in run() and other methods) refer to self.query_register. This aligns the template with the solution and the problem statement's intent to have a query_register attribute.
